GK-PAR-001.name: Parahebe
GK-PAR-001.subtitle: A compact evergreen shrub with small flowers and glossy foliage.

quickCare.Water: Water while establishing and during prolonged dry spells; avoid waterlogging
quickCare.Feeding: Light balanced feed in spring if needed
quickCare.Pruning: Trim lightly after flowering and remove damaged growth

GK-PAR-001.notes: Some plants formerly sold as Parahebe are now classified botanically within Veronica.
GK-PAR-001.soil: Moist but well-drained soil, sheltered from cold drying winds.
GK-PAR-001.medium: Peat-free compost with added grit for container drainage.

seasonalActions.Spring: Remove winter damage and feed lightly if growth is weak.
seasonalActions.Summer: Water during prolonged dry spells and deadhead if desired.
seasonalActions.Autumn: Avoid hard pruning; check drainage before winter.
seasonalActions.Winter: Protect from cold drying winds and prolonged waterlogging.

problems.name: Drought stress
problems.fix: Water deeply during prolonged dry weather, especially while establishing.

problems.name: Poor drainage
problems.fix: Improve drainage or move to a raised, freer-draining position.

propagation.tips: Use a free-draining propagation mix and keep evenly moist.
propagation.tracker: Record cutting date, rooting result and potting-on date.

pollinator.value: Small flowers can attract bees and other insects.

GK-PAR-001.weeklyFact: Parahebe is still widely used as a garden name even though many species are now placed within Veronica.
